subject: math
description: Use polygon vocabulary, regularity, convexity, interior and exterior angles, and side-count reasoning to solve challenge problems.
learningObjectives: Determine unknown angle measures in polygon problems using clear equations
Use interior and exterior angle relationships to reason about polygons
Find the number of sides of a regular polygon from angle clues
Justify polygon classifications using sides, regularity, and convexity
Show reasoning with diagrams described in words and labeled measurements
prerequisites: Polygon vocabulary including side, vertex, diagonal, regular, and irregular
Classifying polygons by number of sides
Complementary, supplementary, adjacent, and vertical angles
